age.label: Age
age.description: 0 = not come up yet, about 0.75 = mature with a flat top, 1 = old, the margin lifted and wavy. A random once per path gives every mushroom of the troop its own

cap_radius.label: Cap radius
cap_radius.description: Radius of the old cap, the stipe takes its length and width from it. Read for every stipe

length.label: Length
length.description: Length of the grown stipe as a share of the diameter of the old cap, read for every stipe

club.label: Club
club.description: How much thicker the base is than the top on a mature stipe, read for every stipe. A button has a fatter club

points.label: Places
points.description: Where the stipes start, the places on the substrate. Without them the stipes stand where the template puts them
